exotics.name: Divinity

exotics.name: Ergo Sum

exotics.name: Fafnir

exotics.name: Izanagi's Burden
exotics.description: special reload sniper that can consume 4 ammo for very high damage shot

exotics.name: Merciless
exotics.description: stacking massively reduced charge time on hits, has 50% damage perk on kill-reload

exotics.name: One Thousand Voices
exotics.description: delayed scorching explosive bolts, DoT Taken seeker on explosions, 2x tick damage if Witherhoarded

exotics.name: Parasite

exotics.usage: 15% non-power boost is less relevant now, but still has some use cases

exotics.name: Praxic Blade
exotics.description: extremely versatile multi-mode sword with insane ammo economy and variable catalysts
exotics.usage: Hyperblade used for movement, insanely consistent neutral option despite not being very optimal

exotics.name: Alethonym
exotics.description: stackable micro-missile GL that gets ammo creation charges via pickups
exotics.usage: primary movement tool, slow guaranteed ammo gen, fast grapple option

exotics.name: Anarchy

exotics.name: Bastion

exotics.name: D.A.R.C.I.

exotics.name: Edge of Action

exotics.name: Euphony
exotics.description: adaptive burst linear that spawns 3 threadlings on 2 bursts, has up to 50% damage after 25 threadling hits

exotics.name: Heirloom
exotics.description: explosive bolts, heat generated by ADSing, 3 stage charge that increases damage and scorch stacks, has Incandescent

exotics.name: Tessellation
exotics.description: enhanced Demo and Transcendence gains, consumes grenade to create explosive projectile with secondary splash effect

exotics.name: The Fourth Horseman
exotics.description: increasing successive shot damage, refills ammo based on rank of killed enemy

exotics.name: Turncoat

exotics.name: Wavesplitter

exotics.name: Ager's Scepter

exotics.name: Arbalest

exotics.name: Buried Bloodline
exotics.description: twin tracking bolts, 11 HP on hit, Devour on 4 minor / 1 elite+ kill, weaken on hit with Devour

exotics.name: Collective Obligation

exotics.name: Cull's Shadow

exotics.name: Delicate Tomb

exotics.name: Dragon's Breath

exotics.name: Graviton Lance
exotics.description: chaining void explosion and seeker orbs on kill, has Turnabout

exotics.name: Ice Breaker

exotics.usage: ammo mechanic can be situationally useful, also can pair with stasis builds

exotics.name: Khvostov 7G-0X

exotics.name: Legend of Acrius

exotics.name: The Lament

exotics.name: Trinity Ghoul

exotics.name: Wolfsbane

exotics.name: Cerberus+1
